lines.text: Many learners say: Can I make a photo of you?
Better: Can I take a photo of you?
Take! Let me take a photo.

data.wrong: Can I make a photo of you?
data.right: Can I take a photo of you?

native.tip: Фото — с глаголом “take”: “Can I take a photo of you?”
native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “Can I make a photo of you”? 😅 По-русски «сделать фото», и хочется “make”, но с photo нужно “take.” Правильно: “Can I take a photo of you?” Послушай Аму и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “take.” С photo — take. Напиши своё предложение с “take a photo.” Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.tip: With photo, use “take”: “Can I take a photo of you?”
en.caption: Do you also say “Can I make a photo of you”? 😅 In Russian you “make” a photo, so “make” feels right, but with photo you need “take.” Correct: “Can I take a photo of you?” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
